```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(FITSio)
library(LaplacesDemon)
```

```{r}
fits_data <- readFITS("./v1/hlsp_phat_hst_wfc3-ir_12058-m31-b01-f06_f110w_v1_drz.fits", hdu = 3)

hst_matrix <- fits_data$imDat

min_val <- min(hst_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
shifted_matrix <- hst_matrix - min_val + 1

log_matrix <- log10(shifted_matrix)

image(log_matrix, col = gray.colors(256), useRaster = TRUE)
```

```{r}
run_fixed_n_sampler <- function(
  hst_matrix,
  num_stars = 18,
  iterations = 10000,
  psf_sigma = 1.2,
  noise_sd = NULL,
  position_step = 0.4,
  log_amplitude_step = 0.1,
  burn_in = floor(iterations / 2),
  thin = 10
) {
  m <- as.matrix(hst_matrix)
  valid <- is.finite(m)

  if (!any(valid)) {
    stop("The image has no finite pixels.")
  }

  background <- median(m[valid])

  # Approximate noise from adjacent-pixel differences.
  # Prefer a supplied noise estimate for scientific analysis.
  if (is.null(noise_sd)) {
    differences <- m[-1, , drop = FALSE] -
      m[-nrow(m), , drop = FALSE]
    noise_sd <- mad(
      differences[is.finite(differences)]
    ) / sqrt(2)
  }

if (is.null(noise_sd)) {
  # Exclude non-finite values and exact zeros, commonly used
  # for unobserved pixels in drizzled images.
  usable <- is.finite(m) & m != 0

  left <- m[-nrow(m), , drop = FALSE]
  right <- m[-1, , drop = FALSE]

  valid_pairs <- usable[-nrow(m), , drop = FALSE] &
    usable[-1, , drop = FALSE]

  differences <- right[valid_pairs] - left[valid_pairs]

  if (length(differences) < 100) {
    stop(
      "Too few usable pixel pairs. Check the science HDU ",
      "or supply noise_sd from a background region."
    )
  }

  noise_sd <- mad(differences) / sqrt(2)
}

  if (burn_in >= iterations || thin < 1 || psf_sigma <= 0) {
    stop("Check burn_in, thin, and psf_sigma.")
  }

  nx <- nrow(m)
  ny <- ncol(m)

  # Same indexing convention as image(): first index is x.
  pixels <- which(valid, arr.ind = TRUE)
  pixel_x <- pixels[, 1]
  pixel_y <- pixels[, 2]
  observed <- m[valid]

  psf <- function(x, y) {
    exp(
      -((pixel_x - x)^2 + (pixel_y - y)^2) /
        (2 * psf_sigma^2)
    )
  }

  # Use the previous peak finder for initialization only.
  initial <- find_stars(
    m,
    num_stars = num_stars,
    min_separation = max(2, 3 * psf_sigma)
  )$final_state

  if (length(initial$x) != num_stars) {
    stop("Could not initialize all requested stars.")
  }

  state <- initial

  initial_pixels <- m[cbind(round(state$x), round(state$y))]
  state$log_amplitude <- log(
    pmax(initial_pixels - background, noise_sd)
  )

  # Proper, bounded uniform prior on log amplitude.
  # These default bounds should be checked for your dataset.
  amplitude_scale <- max(
    max(observed) - background,
    noise_sd
  )
  log_amplitude_bounds <- log(
    c(noise_sd / 100, amplitude_scale * 100)
  )

  model <- rep(background, length(observed))

  for (j in seq_len(num_stars)) {
    model <- model +
      exp(state$log_amplitude[j]) * psf(state$x[j], state$y[j])
  }

  residual <- observed - model
  accepted <- 0L

  save_at <- seq.int(burn_in + 1L, iterations, by = thin)
  history_x <- matrix(NA_real_, length(save_at), num_stars)
  history_y <- matrix(NA_real_, length(save_at), num_stars)
  history_amplitude <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    length(save_at),
    num_stars
  )
  saved <- 0L

  for (iter in seq_len(iterations)) {
    j <- sample.int(num_stars, 1)

    proposed_x <- state$x[j] + rnorm(1, sd = position_step)
    proposed_y <- state$y[j] + rnorm(1, sd = position_step)
    proposed_log_a <- state$log_amplitude[j] +
      rnorm(1, sd = log_amplitude_step)

    inside_prior <- proposed_x >= 1 && proposed_x <= nx &&
      proposed_y >= 1 && proposed_y <= ny &&
      proposed_log_a >= log_amplitude_bounds[1] &&
      proposed_log_a <= log_amplitude_bounds[2]

    if (inside_prior) {
      old_source <- exp(state$log_amplitude[j]) *
        psf(state$x[j], state$y[j])

      new_source <- exp(proposed_log_a) *
        psf(proposed_x, proposed_y)

      change <- new_source - old_source

      # Gaussian log-likelihood difference.
      # Symmetric proposals and uniform priors in x, y, log(A)
      # mean the proposal and prior ratios cancel within bounds.
      log_acceptance <- (
        sum(residual * change) - 0.5 * sum(change^2)
      ) / noise_sd^2

      if (log(runif(1)) < min(0, log_acceptance)) {
        state$x[j] <- proposed_x
        state$y[j] <- proposed_y
        state$log_amplitude[j] <- proposed_log_a
        residual <- residual - change
        accepted <- accepted + 1L
      }
    }

    if (iter > burn_in && (iter - burn_in - 1L) %% thin == 0L) {
      saved <- saved + 1L
      history_x[saved, ] <- state$x
      history_y[saved, ] <- state$y
      history_amplitude[saved, ] <- exp(state$log_amplitude)
    }
  }

  list(
    final_state = list(
      x = state$x,
      y = state$y,
      amplitude = exp(state$log_amplitude)
    ),
    history_x = history_x,
    history_y = history_y,
    history_amplitude = history_amplitude,
    acceptance_rate = accepted / iterations,
    background = background,
    noise_sd = noise_sd
  )
}
```

```{r}
results <- run_fixed_n_sampler(
  hst_matrix = hst_matrix,
  num_stars = 18,
  iterations = 100000
)

img_w <- ncol(log_matrix)
img_h <- nrow(log_matrix)

log_matrix <- log10(
  hst_matrix - min(hst_matrix, na.rm = TRUE) + 1
)

image(
  x = seq_len(nrow(log_matrix)),
  y = seq_len(ncol(log_matrix)),
  z = log_matrix,
  col = gray.colors(256, start = 0, end = 1),
  useRaster = TRUE,
  asp = 1,
  xlab = "X Pixels",
  ylab = "Y Pixels"
)

points(
  results$final_state$x,
  results$final_state$y,
  col = "cyan",
  pch = 3,
  cex = 1.5,
  lwd = 2
)
```
